item.tib: sngags kyi mdo 'dus rin chen phreng ba mu cho'i khroms 'dur chen mo las rin chen phreng gzhon gi nyin bon le'u gnyis pa
item.note: the title in ytkc differs: gzhung gi nyin bon le'u gnyis pa. according to the title, this should be a second chapter (the first chapter would be equivalent to the preceding text).
